requirement: Concurrent Workers may idempotently register the same immutable Job Pack without startup failure or partial catalog state.
rootCause: Control Plane executes Job Pack upsert, child delete and child inserts as independent autocommit statements; two Workers interleave the replace sequence and one receives a duplicate BAT_JOB_PACK_JOB primary key error.
physicalEvidence: Fresh R38 Worker 1 aborts JobPackReporter startup on HTTP 500; Control Plane logs DuplicateKeyException for CPF-BAT-DIAGNOSTIC-CPF_BAT_DIAGNOSTIC_JOB.
